# Test Corpus

Real-world ODF fixtures with **LibreOffice-native structure**, used by
`tests/test_corpus.py` to verify that every v0.2–v0.8 helper works against
files our own generators did not produce.

## Why this exists

All other tests run against ODFs generated by `create_minimal_*` plus our
`add_*` scripts. Those share one structural shape. Real LibreOffice output
differs — more `office:automatic-styles`, a fully-populated `settings.xml`,
extra `font-face-decls`, `loext:` extensions, different element ordering. A
helper can pass every existing test and still break on a real file. This
corpus closes that blind spot.

## How the fixtures were made

Each fixture is round-tripped through LibreOffice:

1. Generated with `create_minimal_*` from a JSON spec.
2. Enriched with the relevant `add_*` skills (footnotes, citations, charts,
   animations, connectors, ...).
3. Converted through `soffice --headless --convert-to <fmt>`, which
   re-serializes the document into LibreOffice-native structure.

The committed `.od[tpsg]` files are the round-tripped result.

## Regenerating

```bash
python3 tests/fixtures/corpus/build_corpus.py
```

Requires LibreOffice. Run this when the skill scripts change in ways that
affect ODF structure. The build script is a maintainer tool — it is **not**
run in CI; the committed fixtures are.

## License

MIT. All content is authored by this project; the fixtures contain no
third-party material. LibreOffice is only used as a format converter.

## Inventory

| Fixture | Exercises |
| --- | --- |
| `odt-minimal.odt` | headings, paragraphs, lists |
| `odt-footnotes.odt` | `text:note` footnotes |
| `odt-citations.odt` | `text:bibliography-mark` citations |
| `odt-crossrefs.odt` | `text:bookmark` + `text:bookmark-ref` |
| `odt-math.odt` | embedded MathML `Object N/` |
| `ods-minimal.ods` | sheets, typed cells |
| `ods-formulas.ods` | `table:formula` cells |
| `ods-named-ranges.ods` | `table:named-range` |
| `ods-chart.ods` | embedded chart `Object N/` |
| `odp-minimal.odp` | slides, titles |
| `odp-animation.odp` | shape animations |
| `odp-transition.odp` | slide transitions |
| `odp-master.odp` | customized master page |
| `odg-minimal.odg` | basic shapes |
| `odg-connectors.odg` | shape-bound connectors |
| `odg-groups.odg` | `draw:g` groups |
| `odg-gluepoints.odg` | `draw:glue-point` anchors |
